- "Not covered":

response.missing: The timeline requirement to begin on-site work within 10 working days following contract award is not mentioned in the proposal.
response.reasoning: The proposal slides outline a 20-week workplan starting with Phase 1 (Listen), but they do not contain any commitment regarding starting on-site work within 10 working days of contract award.
